{{Top}}
The '''PA-9r long-range phased tachyon detection array''' was manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]]. It was equipped in [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] and [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]], where the unit was integrated into the [[ANs-5d "lock track" full-spectrum transceiver]].
